title: Arc de Triomphe
blurb: Napoleon’s 50 m triumphal arch on the Place Charles de Gaulle, completed 1836: four piers, a 29 m vault, Rude’s La Marseillaise, and the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier beneath.

sourceUrls.label: Centre des monuments nationaux: Arc de Triomphe

systems.name: Base
systems.description: The platform and steps the arch stands on.

systems.name: Piers
systems.description: The four great piers in coursed stone, carrying the vaults.

systems.name: Main arch
systems.description: The 29.19 m main vault: voussoir rings front and back with a keystone.

systems.name: Spandrels
systems.description: The spandrel walls filling above the main arch.

systems.name: Side vaults
systems.description: The smaller 18.68 m transverse vaults through the piers.

systems.name: Attic and terrace
systems.description: The attic storey with its terrace, reached by 284 steps.

systems.name: Frieze
systems.description: Frieze panels carrying the names of victories and generals.

systems.name: Sculptures
systems.description: The colossal relief groups including Rude’s La Marseillaise, and the attic shields.

systems.name: Vault interior
systems.description: The barrel-vaulted interior of the main arch.

systems.name: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
systems.description: The tomb beneath the vault with its eternal flame, rekindled daily.
